basic_details.short_information: Dr. D. Y. Patil Pratishthan has invited applications for one post of Principal, open to all, at D.Y.Patil College of Engineering & Technology, Kasaba Bawada, Kolhapur. Applications go to the undersigned, the President of the Pratishthan, within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement. The notice is dated 4 November 2026, which puts the deadline at about 19 November 2026 (15 days from 4 November 2026).

qualification.details: Educational qualifications, pay scales and service conditions are as prescribed by the Apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time. The notice treats the post as open category, as per the decision of the Hon'ble High Court, Aurangabad bench in W/P No.3108/2023, the special leave petition before the Hon'ble Supreme Court in W/P No. 4172/2024, and letter No.RJD/HE/KD/CIRCULAR/2024/2119 Dt.09/05/2024 of the Regional Joint Director, Kolhapur Region, Kolhapur. Applicants who are already in service should apply through proper channel. | Candidates should check the official notification and the prescribed norms for the exact qualification, experience and pay of the Principal post.

content_sections.heading: D.Y.Patil College of Engineering & Technology Principal at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit, the application fee or the selection process.

content_sections.heading: About D.Y.Patil College of Engineering & Technology
content_sections.text: D.Y.Patil College of Engineering & Technology is run by Dr. D. Y. Patil Pratishthan at Kasaba Bawada, Kolhapur – 416 006, Tal- Karveer. The notice describes it as "Permanently Non Granted". The notice is to be published at www.unishivaji.ac.in .

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The college address printed on the notice is D.Y.Patil College of Engineering & Technology, Kasaba Bawada, Kolhapur – 416 006.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational qualifications, pay scales and service conditions are as prescribed by the Apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time. The notice treats the post as open category, as per the decision of the Hon'ble High Court, Aurangabad bench in W/P No.3108/2023, the special leave petition before the Hon'ble Supreme Court in W/P No. 4172/2024, and letter No.RJD/HE/KD/CIRCULAR/2024/2119 Dt.09/05/2024 of the Regional Joint Director, Kolhapur Region, Kolhapur. Applicants who are already in service should apply through proper channel. Candidates should check the official notification and the prescribed norms for the exact qualification, experience and pay of the Principal post.

rows.pay: As prescribed from time to time

content_sections.heading: Term of Appointment
content_sections.text: Appointment to the post of Principal will be for a period of 5 years from the date of appointment or up to the attainment of the age of superannuation of the candidate, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q1. How many Principal posts are vacant at D.Y.Patil College of Engineering & Technology, Kolhapur?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacant post of Principal, and the reservation shown is Open to All - 01.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Principal post?
faq.answer: The notice asks for applications within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement. Counted from the notice date of 4 November 2026, that is about 19 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Principal post?
faq.answer: The notice says educational qualifications are as prescribed by the Apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply for the Principal post?
faq.answer: Apply giving full particulars to the undersigned, the President of Dr. D.Y. Patil Pratishthan, Kolhapur, within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for the Principal post?
faq.answer: Pay scales and service conditions are as prescribed by the Apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time.

faq.question: Q6. For how long is the Principal appointed?
faq.answer: The appointment is for 5 years from the date of appointment or up to the attainment of the age of superannuation, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q7. Is the Principal post reserved for any category?
faq.answer: No. The post is shown as Open to All - 01 and is treated as open category, as per the High Court decision and the letter of the Regional Joint Director, Kolhapur Region cited in the notice.

faq.question: Q8. Can a person already in service apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants who are already in service should apply through proper channel.

faq.question: Q9. Will an incomplete application be accepted?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that an incomplete application will not be entertained.
